beats.text: A chatbot answers. An agent acts.
beats.say: A chatbot answers. An agent acts. Ask both to book the cheapest flight, and only one of them will actually book it.

beats.text: An agent is an LLM in a loop.
beats.say: An AI agent is a language model in a loop. It looks at the goal, decides on an action, uses a tool, observes the result, and repeats until the job is done.

beats.text: Tools: how an agent touches the world.
beats.say: Tools are how an agent touches the real world: searching the web, running code, calling an API, reading and writing files.

beats.text: Each step is guided by what it just learned.
beats.say: Ask it for the cheapest flight. It searches, compares the results, picks one, and books it, with each step guided by what it just learned.

beats.text: Agents need limits, logs, and human approval.
beats.say: But agents can loop forever, pick the wrong tool, or make mistakes that compound. So they need limits, logging, and human approval for risky actions.

beats.text: Next up: tool calling. Follow for more!
beats.say: Next up, tool calling. Follow for more agentic AI.
